actual_sql_query:
WITH ordered AS (
 SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid), p.oid) AS ordinal,
 p.oid::integer AS oid,p.proname AS name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_args,
 pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS full_wrapper_definition,
 md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_md5,length(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_characters,
 p.prosrc AS c_symbol,p.probin AS shared_library,p.provolatile::text AS volatility,p.proparallel::text AS parallel,
 p.prosecdef AS security_definer,p.proisstrict AS strict,p.proleakproof AS leakproof,p.procost AS planner_cost,
 has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS anon_execute,
 has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS authenticated_execute,
 has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS service_execute,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_conversion cv WHERE cv.conproc=p.oid) AS encoding_registration_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_ts_template t WHERE t.tmplinit=p.oid OR t.tmpllexize=p.oid) AS textsearch_registration_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_language l2 WHERE l2.lanplcallfoid=p.oid OR l2.laninline=p.oid OR l2.lanvalidator=p.oid) AS language_registration_count
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang
 WHERE n.nspname='pg_catalog' AND l.lanname='c') SELECT * FROM ordered ORDER BY ordinal
